def solve(inp):
    A=np.array(inp); H,W=A.shape
    ma=np.argwhere(A==8); mr0,mr1,mc0,mc1=ma[:,0].min(),ma[:,0].max(),ma[:,1].min(),ma[:,1].max()

        best=None;bd=1e9

                    best=(name,r,c,bd)
        cands.append(best)
    print('cands',cands)
    # pick smallest bd
    best=min(cands,key=lambda x:(x[3] if x else 99,x[1],x[2]))
    name,r,c,_=best
    out=[list(map(int,r)) for r in A.tolist()]
    src=f(A[r:r+h,c:c+w])
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            out[mr0+i][mc0+j]=src[i][j]
